intent: Specify the public functions `quantiles::greenwald_khanna::find_insert_pos(vs: &[T], v: &T) -> usize` and `find_insert_pos_linear(vs: &[T], v: &T) -> usize`, instantiated at `T = i32`. In Lean they are `greenwald_khanna.find_insert_pos core.I32.Insts.CoreCmpOrd vs v` and `greenwald_khanna.find_insert_pos_linear core.I32.Insts.CoreCmpOrd vs v` with `vs : Slice Std.I32`, `v : Std.I32`.

manual_mutants.note: elements equal to the pivot send the search to the left half (v <= pivot instead of v < pivot)

edits.after: (fun inst a b => do let r ← core.Shared1A.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdShared0B.gt inst a b; ok (!r))

manual_mutants.note: linear scan returns the lower bound (first element >= v) instead of the upper bound

edits.after: (fun inst a b => do let r ← core.Shared1A.Insts.CoreCmpPartialOrdShared0B.gt inst a b; ok (!r))

manual_mutants.note: right half starts after the pivot, but the offset is not adjusted (off by one for large slices)
manual_mutants.after: T) vs { start := (if middle.val + 1 ≤ i.val then ⟨middle.bv + 1⟩ else middle) }

manual_mutants.note: linear scan returns len - 1 when every element is <= v
manual_mutants.after: | core.option.Option.None => let i ← (do let n ← core.slice.Slice.len vs; if n = 0#usize then ok n else n - 1#usize)

manual_mutants.note: left half sliced as [0, middle - 1): drops the element just before the pivot

sibling_mutants.note: compares v with the element just before the middle (still correct on sorted input, different on unsorted)
sibling_mutants.after: let pivot ← (do let m ← middle - 1#usize; Slice.index_usize vs m)

sibling_mutants.note: switches to the linear scan only for slices of length <= 3

bug_variants.source: injected regression (promoted manual mutant #0); no usable historical fix found upstream
bug_variants.note: plausible comparison regression in the binary-search step of find_insert_pos: elements equal to the pivot send the search into the left half, so for slices longer than 10 the returned position can precede elements equal to v, contradicting the documented contract (element at i-1 <= v < element at i) and disagreeing with find_insert_pos_linear
